_doc: Smoke-test config. Copy to smoke-test.json (gitignored) and fill in.
_doc_collect: Every collection-bearing block (cashout, bill, topup, voucher, product, subscription, cashin) can opt in to a real POST /v2/collectstd by adding: "collect": true plus "customerPhonenumber" and "customerEmailaddress" (and optionally customerName, customerAddress, customerNumber, serviceNumber, tag, callbackUrl, cdata, trid). Without "collect": true the harness stays quote-only. The cashin block below shows the opt-in shape under leading-underscore keys so it stays dormant in this template; drop the underscores to enable. WARNING: an enabled opt-in MOVES REAL MONEY when run online.

cashin._optin_collect: For cashin, customerPhonenumber is the RECIPIENT's MSISDN — money flows INTO that wallet.
